summary: Xylem Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a public offering of $500M 5.200% Senior Notes due 2033 and $500M 5.450% Senior Blue Notes due 2036. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, ranking equally with existing unsecured debt. They are redeemable at Xylem's option and contain customary covenants. Proceeds from the 2033 Notes will be used to repay or redeem existing 3.250% Senior Notes maturing November 2026; proceeds from the 2036 Blue Notes will fund eligible blue projects. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
